purpose: UI concept exploration; values and gameplay imagery are illustrative
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished high-fidelity responsive web UI design concept image for the existing project "ps2-web-recomp", a PS2 game player running in a browser. Concept 01 "Focus". A landscape design presentation containing a large desktop browser UI on the left and a complete readable portrait mobile browser UI on the right, neutral dark backdrop, straight-on flat screens, no photographic devices. Deep charcoal surfaces, restrained icy blue accent, crisp modern typography, subtle borders, generous spacing, professional shipped product quality. Game is Kingdom Hearts II; use a stylized warm 3D island village game scene inside a 4:3 viewport. Desktop: compact header with project name, game title, green "Running" pill, "Settings" and fullscreen icon. Large game display and elegant compact metric cards beneath: "50.0 FPS", "GPU time share 32%", "Wasm heap 512 MiB", "Audio buffer 42 ms". Small "Performance details" disclosure. Mobile is the priority: title header, aspect-correct game viewport, below it a beautifully legible TWO COLUMN metric card grid with large numeric values and short captions (never a single line of text), large touch-friendly analog stick and four PS2 shape buttons in a separate controller area, Select and Start buttons, bottom icon toolbar "Play" "Performance" "Settings". No control or stats obscures the picture. Mobile safe-area and comfortable 44px tap targets. Header to footer fully visible. Include a tiny explicit caption "Illustrative values" on the design board. Label GPU with "Time share, not device utilization" in small legible helper text in expanded mini tooltip. Memory is allocated heap, no memory percentage or fake memory usage gauge. Main impression should be beautiful game-first interface with quiet useful telemetry, tangible implementation-ready layout. Board heading "01 / FOCUS" and subheading "Play first. Details when needed." No marketing website, no hero slogans inside application, no invented hardware usage, no unreadable dense text. Landscape high-resolution composition.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished high-fidelity responsive web UI design presentation for "ps2-web-recomp" PS2 browser game player. Concept 02 "Performance". Wide landscape image with desktop interface left two-thirds and complete portrait mobile interface right third. Flat front-on application screenshots, no physical devices, no perspective. Advanced beautiful developer-friendly dark dashboard aesthetic, midnight navy, teal/cyan sparklines, amber only for warnings, typographic clarity, refined compact cards, subtle hairline grid. Existing game Kingdom Hearts II playing a warm colorful stylized 3D town scene inside 4:3 viewport. Desktop header project name / Kingdom Hearts II / "Running" and gear. Gameplay viewport left, well-organized performance sidebar right. Sidebar heading "Performance", large "50.0 FPS" and target "Target 50", tiny frame pacing sparkline. Separate GPU card "GPU time share" "32%" progress bar and helper "Measured GPU time / elapsed time". Memory card "Wasm heap" "512 MiB" and helper "Allocated memory". Worker activity card with three distinctly labeled horizontal percent bars "Emulation 82%" "Vector unit 64%" "Graphics 58%", caption "Active estimate: 100% minus idle". Audio "Buffer 42 ms". Secondary detail "VU interpreter fallback 0 calls/s". Avoid hardware CPU utilization or VRAM invented values. Mobile design shows same product with game viewport above an EXPANDED BOTTOM SHEET titled "Performance", drag handle, tabs "Overview" "Threads", a clean two-column grid for FPS and GPU, memory/audio beneath, three clear full-width worker bars. The performance sheet occupies its own lower region and never overlays game image; bottom navigation "Play" "Performance" "Settings". Small visible "Close" control to return to touch gameplay. Most space dedicated to real UI with readable labels and metric hierarchy. Board title "02 / PERFORMANCE" subtitle "Understand the work behind every frame." Tiny "Illustrative values". Application needs no fake battery, fake hardware sensors, marketing, or paragraphs. Professional attractive actual web UI mockup, legible sans-serif text.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity beautiful responsive design concept image for "ps2-web-recomp", existing PS2 web game player, Concept 03 "Console". A wide landscape concept board with large desktop app view left and complete portrait mobile app view right, flat front view, no photographed devices. Distinct editorial console aesthetic: warm off-white/light stone application chrome, dark ink typography, cobalt blue accents, rounded cards, soft minimal shadows, playful small PS2 geometry symbols tastefully placed. Spacious and premium rather than neon dashboard. Game Kingdom Hearts II using warm colorful 3D island-town gameplay in correctly shaped 4:3 black-bordered viewport. Desktop top title "ps2-web-recomp", title "Kingdom Hearts II", pill "Running", compact controls "Resolution 1×", fullscreen. Under game, graceful card strip with clearly stacked label and value, not continuous text: "Frame rate 50.0 FPS", "GPU time share 32%", "Wasm heap 512 MiB", "Audio buffer 42 ms". One tidy drawer "Performance details" and footer actions "Import card" "Export card". Mobile: clean narrow header, game display full width, 2-by-2 metric tile grid below game, large comfortable controller area with round thumbstick, directional pad and face shape buttons, Start/Select, small bottom toolbar with "Play", "Stats", "Settings". Layout should be plausible on a single portrait phone screen: enough height for all with no overflow, no horizontal scrolling. Include a small magnified detail callout on board if room: GPU card "32%" with label "GPU time share" and note "GPU time / elapsed time", memory card note "Allocated Wasm memory"; no utilization claim or memory usage percent. Board title "03 / CONSOLE" subtitle "A calmer, touch-friendly player." small caption "Illustrative values". Large readable numeric metrics, clear hierarchy, accessible contrast on light surfaces, 44px touch targets, mobile safe area. Restrained polished authentic product UI, not a promotional landing page.
